tickets.title: fork: sidebar.set_hud projection, request crown, +N prj and the minimal rail's HUD marks
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud (dispatch with cwd there; land via its own land block). D-2026-11-27-05, design `~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/README.md`, frames C1/C3/C5 in `~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/tui/preview.mjs`. Add one bounded API `sidebar.set_hud` (generation-tagged JSON, bounded size, leased like `pane.strip.set` so an expired lease shows `·` stale instead of frozen marks; documented in HUD-FORK.md) carrying: owner requests (count, first request's project, age, sentence), launcher counts, extra project count, and per-run graph data keyed by `hud_group`/`hud_subgroup` (consumed by unified-left/03, only stored here). Draw from it: the crown above `spaces` when requests exist (0 rows when calm: `?N project · waits age` + the sentence), the launcher row `◆ Home Proj Exec·N Ctrl` (click sends `sidebar.hud_activate {gen, target}` as an event HUD subscribes to), `+N prj` in the spaces header (activates Home). In the existing 4-column folded sidebar: `?N` as the top row when requests exist, and folded groups show their strongest state shape before the count (`▸×2`). Every existing sidebar function stays unchanged.

tickets.title: HUD publishes the sidebar projection on change and opens pages from sidebar clicks
tickets.live_try: Main: with the fork from unified-left/01 installed, file and resolve a synthetic owner request and watch the crown; click each launcher item.
tickets.what: MyHUD side of unified-left/01. D-2026-11-27-05, design `docs/design/unified-left/README.md`. The running panel (or hud-watch when no panel runs) builds the projection from the same facts Home uses (owner requests with Home's order and rule, active-today projects, runs and their steps with state, role glyph and live pane id) and sends `sidebar.set_hud` only when it changes. Event-driven: watch jobs-revision.json, flows/, unattended records and every registered project's `.hud/` and STATE.md (STATE.md edits do not bump jobs-revision.json); no timer. Renew the lease while alive. Handle `sidebar.hud_activate`: open the named page (Home, Project, Execution, Control; Execution at a run/step when the target names one) in today's panel.

acceptance.text: Unit tests: projection built from fixture state matches Home's requests and runs; unchanged state sends nothing
Test: editing a fixture STATE.md waiting item updates the projection without a timer
Test: hud_activate targets open the matching page and step
Live try by main on the installed fork: an owner request appears in the crown within a second and clears when resolved

tickets.title: fork: running workflows as miniature graphs in the agents tree and the 13-column rail
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud. D-2026-11-27-05, frames C1 and C3 in `~/projects/MyHUD/docs/design/unified-left/tui/preview.mjs`. In the expanded agents section, a `hud_subgroup` that has run data in the projection renders as `run <name>  age` followed by its miniature graph (parallel steps fanned with box rules, then review/accept), `▾/▸` folding it; state shape glued before the role glyph. A step with a live pane is a hit that focuses it (peeks a hidden tab); any other step emits `sidebar.hud_activate` for Execution at that step. Add the 13-column folded form (C3): workspace number + short name, the request row, the graph in miniature, glued pairs for workers outside runs. `sidebar_collapsed_mode` gains `rail` (13) beside `compact` (4) and `hidden` (0), rail the new default; folded width never changes with runs. Add a per-client preference command so HUD Settings can set the folded form (persisted like the other per-client preferences).

Fork tests: live-pane step click focuses the pane; other step clicks emit hud_activate with the step
Fork test: folded widths stay 13/4/0 with and without runs

tickets.title: fork: the dock as a center ◆ HUD tab, hidden on navigation, pinnable at wide widths; narrow header summary
tickets.what: Repo: ~/projects/herdr-hud. D-2026-11-27-05, frames C2 and C4. A new dock placement `center`: the dock terminal fills the pane surface as a peeked tab labelled `[◆ HUD · <page>]` (page name from a HUD-settable label), using the hidden-tab peek semantics; focusing any workspace, tab or agent hides it again (the terminal keeps running); focus, copy mode and zoom work as for the docked forms. At pane-surface widths of at least 112 columns a pin key (`P`, or a `dock.pin` command) shows it as a push split beside the panes instead. Narrow terminals (mobile threshold): header row 2 shows state counts, `?N` and one-line run strips from the projection; the center tab fills the width. Edge placements (left/right/bottom, push/overlay) stay unchanged as settings.

Fork tests: pin works at >=112 columns and is refused below

Fork gate passes; report names the built binary

tickets.what: D-2026-11-27-05. Settings → Panel → Pages: center tab (default) or docked edge (today's side/mode settings). `/hud` in every client, `prefix+d` and launcher clicks show the center tab at the page; `q` hides and returns focus, never quits; the tab label follows the open page.
